proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runners share public IP pools. Unauthenticated calls to Gemini, AI Horde, or Hugging Face fail instantly with 429/403 errors because other GitHub users have exhausted the quotas, halting automated production.
proposals.proposed_fix: Enforce mandatory authenticated-only API routes. Implement a unified HTTP client wrapper with exponential backoff + jitter specifically tailored for GitHub runner environments, and route all image tasks through Cloudflare Workers AI (using account credentials) or Runware PAYG (with explicit API keys) instead of IP-based free endpoints.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates silent workflow failures, ensuring 100% reliable automated nightly runs.

proposals.issue_title: Missing Centralized Image Generation & Fallback SDK
proposals.current_pain_description: Image generation logic is fragmented across multiple pipelines. Changing from Pollinations to Runware or Together AI requires editing multiple scripts, increasing maintenance overhead and code duplication.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a single helper module `lib_image_gen.py` implementing a Provider-Fallback Pattern (Together AI -> Cloudflare Workers -> Runware PAYG -> Pollinations as absolute fallback). It should standardize prompts, handle resolution scaling, and return unified image metadata.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: High code maintainability; allows swapping the entire image-gen infrastructure with a single environment variable change.

proposals.issue_title: Manual Asset Download and Transfer Bottleneck on Mobile
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates solely from an Android phone (Termux). Downloading high-resolution books, heavy PDFs, or massive zip archives to his phone to manually upload them to KDP or Cults3D is slow, consumes mobile data, and risks storage limits.
proposals.proposed_fix: Configure GitHub Actions to automatically upload final output assets (PDFs, ZIPs, PNGs) directly to a free Cloudflare R2 bucket (10GB free tier) or Google Drive via API. The runner should then output a clean Markdown summary containing direct download links and auto-generated platform copy (tags, description, title) to a single GitHub Issue or Telegram bot notification.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves hours of mobile download/upload time; reduces Hugo's manual intervention to a simple copy-paste of links and metadata.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Quality Failures in Line Art and Coloring Pages
proposals.current_pain_description: AI-generated coloring pages frequently contain gray shading, blurry gradients, or broken line structures that make them unmarketable. Reviewing these manually on a phone screen is tedious and error-prone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate an automated OpenCV / Pillow pre-processor in `agent_visual_audit`. The script must check contrast levels, calculate the percentage of pure black vs. pure white pixels (binarization check), and auto-reject images with excessive grayscale shading before compiling the final PDF book.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures only high-contrast, easily-colorable line art reaches the final book, preventing customer complaints and negative reviews.

proposals.current_pain_description: A high-quality asset (e.g., a hand-crafted SVG quote or idiom) is generated for a single format, missing out on cross-publishing on other platforms (e.g., a quote design can be a sticker on Redbubble, a page in a KDP journal, and a tumbler wrap).
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a 'Syndication Router' in `agent_orchestrator` that triggers post-processing scripts once a high-quality asset is approved. For example, a transparent PNG design should be automatically resized and formatted into: 1) Redbubble sticker dimensions, 2) KDP paperback cover dimensions, 3) Tumbler wrap aspect ratio.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory output by 3x to 4x for every single successful design generated, with zero extra creative effort.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Actions 6-Hour Timeout and Pipeline State Loss
proposals.current_pain_description: Generating a complete coloring book or asset pack requires dozens of API calls. If the workflow times out or encounters a network error on page 35 of 40, the entire run fails, wasting API credits, time, and progress.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement checkpointing/state serialization. Save each successfully generated image and its metadata into a temporary JSON state file, committing progress back to a cache branch in the Git repository. On re-run, the pipeline should read the state and resume exactly where it failed.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents wasted API costs and ensures long-running asset generation processes are robust against network interruptions.
